basic_profile.bio: I'm a high school senior from Ohio, exploring my college options and trying to make sense of the application process. I love gaming, especially FPS games like Battlefield, and enjoy a good laugh with Smosh videos. I'm not a fan of overly complicated systems, which is probably why I'm skeptical about acceptance calculators. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after school and during weekends. Currently single, and aside from school, I'm working part-time at a local bookstore.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is primarily from my high school education and personal interests. I spend a lot of time reading about college admissions and gaming tips online. I'm self-taught in some basic tech stuff, especially anything that helps with gaming setup.
